text: DeepSeek Harness AI 视频工坊是一款面向 Web 客户端的 DSH 视频制作插件，通过 Host 工具接入项目创建、分镜编辑、素材生成、预览和 MP4 导出，并在 Web 对话中显示分镜卡片。它把项目保存为本地文件，支持图片分镜和 HTML 分镜、配音与图像生成、按时间轴生成 SRT/VTT 字幕以及离线预览。适合希望用对话制作讲解视频并逐镜修改的人；图像和语音网关及密钥均可选，未配置时可使用本地标题卡和系统语音。

DeepSeek Harness AI Video Studio adds Host tools and Web storyboard cards for creating projects, editing frames, generating media, and exporting MP4. Projects are stored locally. It supports narration, subtitles, and offline previews; image and speech gateways are optional, with local fallbacks.
想通过 DSH 对话把一个主题整理成分镜并导出讲解视频。
能不能在网页聊天里逐镜调整旁白和画面，再重新生成素材？
I want to turn a short outline into a narrated video with subtitles and a browser preview.
DeepSeek Harness AI 视频工坊的功能「分镜项目编辑」：创建图片或 HTML 模式的视频项目，写入整份分镜，也可逐条更新、插入、删除或移动镜头；旁白与画面变化后可重新生成对应素材。
DeepSeek Harness AI 视频工坊的功能「生成预览与成片」：按镜头生成图像和配音，生成带 SRT/VTT 字幕的离线预览，并可调用本机 ffmpeg 导出 MP4。
DeepSeek Harness AI 视频工坊使用前须知：配置图像或语音网关后，会把分镜画面提示词或旁白文本发送到所配置的接口；对应 API Key 可通过配置提供。未配置网关时可使用本地生成回退。

dsh-plugin-ai-video README · DeepSeek Harness AI 视频工坊：[English](README.en.md) | 中文

`dsh-plugin-ai-video` 把「一句话生成讲解视频」的完整流水线装进 DeepSeek Harness：Agent 负责写分镜、旁白、画面提示词或 HTML 动画，插件负责落盘、生成配音与图像、切字幕、生成浏览器预览播放器，最后用 ffmpeg 导出 MP4。

产品形态与三种视觉风格参考了 [xuanyuanzhifeng/ai-video-agent](https://github.com/xuanyuanzhifeng/ai-video-agent)，本项目是针对 DSH 0.2 插件体系重写的独立实现：没有 Next.js、没有数据库、没有前端构建，安装一个插件包即可使用。

[](https://github.com/flynow-harness/dsh-plugin-ai-video/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

dsh-plugin-ai-video README · 它做什么：- **两种模式**：`image`（每镜一张图）与 `html`（每镜一段网页动画）
- **三种风格**：科技博主 `cyber-clean`、黑客风 `terminal-matrix`、暖色系 `warm-story`
- **三种画幅**：`16:9`、`9:16`、`1:1`（1920×1080 / 1080×1920 / 1080×1080）
- **增量改稿**：`video_edit_frames` 支持 update / insert / remove / move，改旁白自动清理过期配音，改画面自动清理过期图片
- **无 API 也能跑**：Chrome 渲染内置标题卡当分镜，macOS `say` / Linux `espeak-ng` 当配音；配置网关后自动切换为正式服务
- **字幕三件套**：同一份时间轴生成 `.srt`、`.vtt` 和预览播放器字幕层
- **MP4 导出**：H.264 + AAC，本地 ffmpeg 带 libass 时自动烧录字幕
- **文件即项目**：`project.json` 可读、可 diff、可手动修，所有产物都在一个目录里

dsh-plugin-ai-video README · 设计说明：- **不做数据库**：一个项目就是一个目录，`project.json` 是唯一事实来源，Agent 和人都能直接读改。
- **时间轴优先**：每镜时长 = 显式 `durationSec` → 实测配音 + 尾巴 → 旁白字数估算。没有配音也能先预览、先导出。
- **字幕同源**：按标点切片，按字数分配时间，过短的 cue 合并、过长的句子再切，`.srt`、`.vtt`、播放器字幕共用同一份数据。
- **按需付费**：只有配置了网关并且分镜有 `visual` 时才调用图像 API；标题卡、字幕、预览全部本地完成。
- **失败可续**：`video_generate` 逐镜保存，失败的镜头单独列出，可用 `frameIds` 只重跑失败的。

dsh-plugin-ai-video README · 已知限制：- `html` 模式导出 MP4 时，每镜取一张代表帧（约 1.5s 处）；`preview.html` 保留完整动画。需要逐帧动画成片时，建议用 `image` 模式或后续版本。
- 烧录字幕依赖 ffmpeg 的 `subtitles` 滤镜（libass）。Homebrew 官方 `ffmpeg` 未内置，此时字幕以 `.srt`/`.vtt` 外挂输出，预览播放器仍显示字幕。
- 图像网关需兼容 OpenAI `POST /images/generations`（`b64_json` 或 `url`），并兼容任务式 `GET /tasks/{id}` 轮询。
- 项目目录默认在 `$DSH_HOME/ai-video`，不随工作区移动。

dsh-plugin-ai-video README · DeepSeek Harness AI Video Studio：English | [中文](README.md)

`dsh-plugin-ai-video` brings a complete "one sentence → explainer video" pipeline to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). The agent writes the outline, per-frame narration, image prompts or HTML animation; the plugin persists the project, generates narration and stills, builds subtitles and an offline preview player, and renders an MP4 with ffmpeg.

dsh-plugin-ai-video README · DeepSeek Harness AI Video Studio：The product shape and the three visual styles are inspired by [xuanyuanzhifeng/ai-video-agent](https://github.com/xuanyuanzhifeng/ai-video-agent). This project is an independent implementation rebuilt for the DSH 0.2 plugin system: no Next.js, no database, no front-end build — one installable plugin package.

[](https://github.com/flynow-harness/dsh-plugin-ai-video/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

dsh-plugin-ai-video README · Preview：The generated preview player is fully offline: open `preview.html` and play — frames, narration and captions stay in sync, with keyboard and fullscreen controls.

Stills come from a configured image gateway or, with no account at all, from the built-in title cards:

Every tool call renders a storyboard card in the conversation; expand it to see each frame's title, character count, image/audio readiness and duration:

dsh-plugin-ai-video README · What it does：| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Agent | Writes the outline, narration and image prompts; in `html` mode it writes the HTML/CSS/JS animation itself |
| Plugin | Project persistence, TTS, image generation, timing, subtitle segmentation, preview player, ffmpeg MP4 |

dsh-plugin-ai-video README · What it does：- **Two modes**: `image` (one still per frame) and `html` (one web animation per frame)
- **Three styles**: `cyber-clean` (科技博主), `terminal-matrix` (黑客风), `warm-story` (暖色系)
- **Three aspect ratios**: `16:9`, `9:16`, `1:1`
- **Incremental edits**: `video_edit_frames` supports update / insert / remove / move; a changed narration clears its stale audio and a changed visual clears its stale still
- **Works without an account**: headless Chrome renders the built-in title card as a still, macOS `say` / Linux `espeak-ng` provides narration; configure a gateway and the plugin switches to it automatically
- **One subtitle source**: `.srt`, `.vtt` and the preview caption layer are generated from the same cues
- **MP4 export**: H.264 + AAC, burning subtitles when the local ffmpeg has libass
- **Files are the database**: a readable `project.json` plus one directory per project

dsh-plugin-ai-video README · Design notes：- **No database.** A project is a directory and `project.json` is the single source of truth; both the agent and a human can read and edit it.
- **Timeline first.** Frame duration = explicit `durationSec` → measured narration + tail → narration estimate. You can preview and export before any audio exists.
- **Subtitles from one source.** Narration is split at punctuation, timed by character weight, short cues merge and long ones split; `.srt`, `.vtt` and the player share the same cues.
- **Pay only on demand.** The image gateway is called only when it is configured and a frame has a `visual`; title cards, subtitles and preview are local.
- **Resumable generation.** `video_generate` saves each frame as it finishes, reports failures individually, and accepts `frameIds` to retry only those.

dsh-plugin-ai-video README · Known limitations：- `html` mode exports one representative still per frame (around 1.5 s) to MP4; `preview.html` keeps the full animation. Use `image` mode when every frame must be a moving picture.
- Subtitle burn-in needs ffmpeg's `subtitles` filter (libass). Homebrew's stock `ffmpeg` omits it; the `.srt`/`.vtt` still ship beside the video and the preview always shows captions.
- Image gateways must speak OpenAI `POST /images/generations` (`b64_json` or `url`) and, for task-style APIs, `GET /tasks/{id}`.
- Projects default to `$DSH_HOME/ai-video` and do not follow the workspace.
